note.text: Imperial acquisition used treaties, protectorate claims, annexation, concessions and military conquest, often in combination. A concession granted specified rights, not automatically full sovereignty over a whole region. A protectorate claim asserted outside control under a language of protection; annexation claimed incorporation. Military conquest imposed control through force. Mandates belonged to the post-First World War framework and should not be placed before the Cameroon claim in 1884. The historical label does not settle the legitimacy or fairness of the process.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: Imperial acquisition used treaties, protectorate claims, annexation, concessions and military conquest, often in combination. A concession granted specified rights, not automatically full sovereignty over a whole region. A protectorate claim asserted outside control under a language of protection; annexation claimed incorporation. Military conquest imposed control through force. Mandates belonged to the post-First World War framework and should not be placed before the Cameroon claim in {1884}. The historical label does not settle the legitimacy or fairness of the process.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: A company might obtain a concession and then seek official backing. A treaty could be presented as agreement while being shaped by threat or unequal interpretation. After the First World War, former German territories were dealt with under a different international framework. Keep these legal-political forms distinct from the practical degree of control actually achieved.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Ask which rights were claimed, by whom and at what date. Distinguish a resource concession from a transfer of government powers. Do not turn the existence of a written document into evidence that coercion was absent. Sequence mandates after the war rather than using the term for every early annexation.
